## HIGH IMPACT

No high-impact breaking changes identified in this release. The three changed files with styling relevance (`hui-map-card.ts`, `hui-map-overview.ts`, `ha-card-condition-user.ts`) do not rename any CSS custom properties, remove any shadow DOM elements targeted by ha-lcars card-mod rules, or alter any slot/part structure that the theme injects into.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: `hui-map-overview` — New `single-tab` attribute on host element

**What changed:** `hui-map-overview.ts` now calls `this.toggleAttribute("single-tab", tabs.length === 1)` in `updated()`. When there is only one map tab, the host element receives the boolean attribute `single-tab`. This may trigger internal layout changes inside the component (tab strip collapsing or hiding) that affect the rendered height or visible area of the map overview panel.

**Affected ha-lcars rule:** The ha-lcars theme does not currently inject any card-mod CSS targeting `hui-map-overview` directly, nor does it target a `[single-tab]` attribute selector. However, the `hui-panel-view` rules in `card-mod-root-yaml` (the `.: |` block) control panel sizing:

```css
@container view-container (min-width: 0px) {
  hui-panel-view {
    margin: 5px 0px 0px 5px !important;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 45px);
  }
}
```

If `hui-map-overview` changes its internal tab-strip rendering when `single-tab` is present (e.g., the tab bar disappears, reclaiming vertical space), the fixed `max-height: calc(100vh - 45px)` on `hui-panel-view` may produce excess whitespace or clipping at the bottom of the map panel view.

**Suggested fix:** Monitor whether the map panel view gains or loses visible height with single-entity map setups. If clipping or whitespace appears, add an optional rule:

```yaml
card-mod-root-yaml: |
  .: |
    hui-panel-view:has(hui-map-overview[single-tab]) {
      max-height: calc(100vh - 40px); /* adjust as needed */
    }
```

No immediate fix required; observe in a single-tab map configuration.

---

### Component: `hui-map-overview` — `memoizeOne` import and tab recalculation may change tab-strip DOM

**What changed:** `hui-map-overview.ts` adds `memoizeOne` for tab computation and `ifDefined` for attribute binding. The net effect is that tab-related attributes and potentially element counts in the rendered tab strip DOM are now memoized and conditionally set. This may change whether certain child elements exist or are rendered in the shadow DOM of `hui-map-overview` between renders.

**Affected ha-lcars rule:** No ha-lcars card-mod rule currently targets the internal shadow DOM of `hui-map-overview` (no `"hui-map-overview $"` key in `preamble.yaml`). Impact is therefore limited to layout-level side-effects described above.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed unless visual regression is observed on map panel views.

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `hui-map-card` — Auto-fit behavior on overview deselect

**What changed:** `hui-map-card.ts` now calls `this._map?.fitMap({ unpause_autofit: true })` when `_overviewSelected` transitions from a truthy value to `undefined`/falsy in panel layout mode. This is a pure behavior change (map viewport resets to fit all entities when nothing is selected).

**Affected ha-lcars rule:** None. The ha-lcars theme does not inject CSS into `hui-map-card`'s shadow DOM, and this change has no effect on CSS custom properties, element structure, or variable resolution.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.

---

### Component: `ha-card-condition-user` — Duplicate-selection guard logic change

**What changed:** `ha-card-condition-user.ts` adds deduplication guards and an early-return `else` branch in the user-selection event handler. This is a pure logic/state change with no CSS, shadow DOM, or variable implications.

**Affected ha-lcars rule:** None.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed.
